units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jonah 2:4">Targ. Jon. II, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 2:10">Targ. Gen. II, 10</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:3">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> <he>אעברת נ׳ בְּנֵה</he> build (me a house) on the (western) banks of the river.
<cite ref="Gittin 60b:16">Gitt. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>קא מתקיל לנַהֲרִין</he> he spoils our portion of the canal.
<cite ref="Gittin 60b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>נ׳ כפשטיה ליזיל</he> let the canal run its natural course (and those above have no right to dam it before those below have used it for irrigation).

<cite ref="Chullin 18b:9">Ḥull. 18ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>נ׳ נ׳ ופשטיה</he> every river has its own course, i.e. each place has its own usages; <cite ref="Chullin 57a:7">ib. 57ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נַהֲרִין</he>, <he>נַהֲרַיָּא</he>. Targ. Gen. l. c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:1:4">Y. Sabb. VII, 9ᵃ</cite> top, a. e., v. <cite ref="B00130"><he>בְּדִי</he> I</cite>; a. fr.—Fem. forms: <he>נַהַרְוָן</he>, <he>נַהַרְוָתָא</he>, <he>נַהַרְוָו׳</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 43:19">Targ. Is. XLIII, 19</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 24:2">Targ. Ps. XXIV, 2</cite>; a. e.—
Taan. 25ᵃ תליסרי נ׳ וכ׳ thirteen rivers of balsam oil; a. e.—נְהַר in pr. n. of canals or places, e. g. נ׳ אבא N’har Abba, Sabb. 140ᵇ; v. respective determinants (v. Berl. Beitr. Geogr. p. 47).
